rca_of_the_issue.original_bug: User reported: 1) Chat not responding (shows 'Error: Chat request failed'), 2) Chat too big on desktop, 3) Sector Rotation showing 0%

root_cause.chat_error: Frontend sends FormData (with message, sessionId, optional image) but backend expected JSON Pydantic model (ChatRequest). Mismatch caused 422 validation errors.
root_cause.chat_size: Chat panel was 420x600px, too large for desktop sidebar use
root_cause.sector_0_percent: Transient caching issue - Alpha Vantage data was being cached with stale values

fixes_applied: 1. Changed POST /api/chat endpoint from Pydantic JSON body to Form() and File() parameters
2. Reduced chat panel dimensions from 420x600 to 360x480 on desktop (lg:w-[360px] lg:h-[480px])
3. Sector heatmap now fetches fresh Alpha Vantage data with 2-minute cache TTL
rca_of_the_issue.verification_status: All fixes verified working. Chat accepts FormData and returns AI responses. Sector heatmap shows real non-zero values. Chat panel is correctly sized.
